source: docs/log/prompts.jsonl, docs/log/progress.jsonl, docs/log/reviews.jsonl, docs/log/tests.jsonl, git log
method: Every log line and commit is one event, sorted by UTC time. Prompts are Maya's (actor user); progress entries, commits and test runs are Claude's. Commits are authored as Maya Tomarchio because they were made in her repository; Claude wrote their content. Timestamps fixed by a later 'correction' entry are marked corrected; the logs themselves stay append-only.

events.title: Repurpose the course project: instead of genAI-in-CS data, gather and visualize which languages are spoken around the world, in what volumes, where speakers are; globe/map with clickable regions showing language percentages; year slider for change over time; multilingual regions and languages; 'if I speak multiple languages, where could I communicate' with inputs per language. (Course brief pasted: spec-driven agentic development, validation UI, contribution timeline UI, token usage UI, publish to GitHub + web.)
events.detail: Wrote CLAUDE.md and specs (00 project, 01 data, 02 atlas). Built a Python pipeline from open data (Unicode CLDR 46, World Bank population 1960-2024, Glottolog) plus 14 curated census anchor series. Built a static D3 globe/flat-map atlas with 4 layers (languages, multilingualism, diversity, where-can-I-talk), year slider, country/language/region panels. 30 automated tests (16 Python data invariants, 14 JS logic) all pass, logged to docs/log/tests.jsonl.
